introduction: Explore Alatorin's kitchens, workshops, guilds, royal requests, outposts, port and First Mountain shrines. Exact deliveries have independent outcomes; preparation and source history are optional. Active, ready accounting is required. Some paid, mining and material routes await supported settlement.
orientation: Meet the Stonebrew, BrightAxe, Hammerhelm and guild cooks. Each royal dish independently earns a culinary token from the King's attendant; ten current tokens pay Modan. Serving one dish does not complete all four courses.

The outer-city spice merchant supplies mandrake, garlic and green herb; the fruit vendor stocks apples, oranges and bananas; the elven peddler stocks dust, dragon blood and stones; the potion vendor stocks empty bottles. Purchase availability needs accounting-qualified stock.

Dweef trades 209 ordinary salvaged kinds for one fragment each. Ten fragments make one collecting token. Nebula adds copper; vellum gives three fragments; the strange object gives a full token and treasure. Ten tinkerer tokens give only one fragment, and have no ordinary reviewed source.

Ten exact collecting, dragonslaying, mining, cooking, stealth or siege tokens pay Modan for a medal and family-specific gifts. Ten medals earn the honor key; four medals instead buy gnome currency from Dweef. A single token receipt does not establish ten current tokens.

Miboli needs blank paper and two identical components for each arcanum. One of each of ten arcanums makes an enchantment scroll and gnome token. Winterhaven's Lancer supplies all five elemental components for one gem-studded dragon hide; that foreign receipt is optional.

Reciting an enchantment scroll draws one random attribute scroll. Electrum plus two matching scrolls make the corresponding ring. All nine distinct rings plus 500,000 copper make wondrous power. Eighteen random draws do not guarantee a complete matching set; supplied materials remain valid.

Mining, smelting, salvage, refining and paid native offerings currently refuse active accounting. Their journals explain exact supplied-input alternatives. Readiness shows item quantities; it does not guarantee payment support, fresh source issuance or personal preparation.

Gimbrin uses six identical materials plus matching armor and a fee; Xamora uses eight identical materials, two tokens and a fee. Steel/cold iron and wood/leather alternatives are whole recipes. Mixed material batches do not qualify. Mundorno's two overlapping blue-tunic recipes remain separate.

The mystic gardener requests all four distinct flowers together. Mishanen carries all four on separate rare stock rolls; the rose also has ground stock in the Fortress of Dreams. Twin Towers' gardener belt does not gate this local recipe. All three library books yield deadly mist; the Baron separately consumes Jedd's book.

Royal and rival proofs have competing uses: Noroth's head pays Taark, Queen Bellethra or Mundorno; the wedding band pays Taark or the attendant; Kereghaktis's head pays Sturb or Uttan. Guild recipients with equal terms still own separate requests. One current proof cannot pay multiple consumers.

The four northern hearts are declared on carriers in the Alteran Valley dispersal room, despite Frost Sharn wording. Mixt and Lyena have separate Twin Towers carriers. The five dwarven weapons have distinct foreign equipped sources; delivered proofs do not prove your kills or allegiance.

Jenk needs both royal signets for his stealth reward and then leaves. His five potion recipes, all-five elixir recipe and elixir-plus-token upgrade are supporting services. Prepare first or find another available appearance; supplied higher outputs can skip personal preparation.

Deramuth requests include both beast hearts for Ravi, a current mountaineer insignia for Locke, five different brewery casks for Naltem, and two distinct crate buybacks. Egg-to-soup routes compete with egg buyers and food buybacks. Osquip remains can expire before cooking.

The armoire and hidden button use push; the shrine statues use hit; vine travel uses grab. Keys unlock specific doors or containers and can break. An open wall, an unlocked door and confirmed travel are different effects. The malformed abandoned-tower switch and royal blocked gate need builder decisions.

The First Mountain shard passes through independent divine exchanges as replacement copies. Seven gifts do not establish a full pilgrimage; two priests only return it without added gifts. Vergadain's coins and Abbathor's satchel are money-item rewards whose accounting handling needs qualification.

Ask the named contacts about their listed topics for explanations. Dialogue is informational, without a learned-topic achievement. Current supplies and optional earlier receipts help explain preparation; only an accepted final exchange completes its own request. Rare recipients, caps, gifts and recovered stock affect availability.
